changes.result: Reconciliation now performs a first pass that validates unique selected rows and records each executed or reused result artifact digest plus behavioral eligibility. A second pass compares every downstream dependency map to that exact selected upstream postimage before any disposition can be accepted.
Reuse evidence exposes only a crate-private exact dependency-result comparison, preserving opaque witness construction while letting reconciliation reject cross-spliced same-plan artifacts.

Executed and mixed executed/reused multilevel controls reject same-plan A-B substitution, missing selected upstream rows, selected skipped or failed upstream rows, duplicate or unknown rows, stale candidates, reordered reports, and tracked mutation with stable causal errors and zero-write refusal evidence.

The process-group control now waits for an exact ready newline written only after the child process record exists. A delayed-readiness mode proves pre-readiness interruption returns causally with no process record or readiness artifact.

A six-case catalog and direct-path journey target exercise clean no-op, dirty dependency-closed fast planning, conflict-driven strict expansion, explicit optional-accelerator fallback, first execution, exact repeat reuse, mutation-forced miss, record reordering, and recursive zero-write comparisons.

The exact predecessor dependency command expanded from its historical 214-control baseline to 217 current controls by adding two report-chain controls and one interruption-before-readiness control; the expanded surface passed twice without retries.
